name: G3MB-202P solid state relay module
description: Omron G3MB-202P solid state relay (phototriac, zero-cross, built-in snubber) on a 1-channel module: switches AC mains loads of 0.1–2 A at 75–264 VAC with no moving contacts. AC loads only: a triac does not turn off on DC. Module supply 5 VDC (SSR input range 4–6 VDC). Sold as: 1-channel 5V G3MB-202P SSR module, high level trigger, with resistive fuse (input header DC+, DC-, CH1; output screw terminal A1/B1).
eli5: A silent electronic switch for mains-powered things like a lamp or heater: when your board says on, the lamp gets power.

pins.name: DC+
pins.description: Module supply, 5 V (SSR input rated 4–6 VDC); use the board's 5V/VBUS pin, not 3V3

pins.name: CH1
pins.description: Control input, high level trigger: high (3–5 V) = SSR on, low (below 0.5 V) = off. A 3.3 V GPIO is enough.

supplierQuery: G3MB-202P solid state relay module 1 channel 5V high level trigger
buildNotes: Check the board: this model is the HIGH level trigger module (CH1 high = on). Low level trigger versions with the same DC+/DC-/CH1 header also exist; on those the logic is inverted and a 3.3 V GPIO may not switch them fully off.
AC loads only (75–264 VAC, 0.1–2 A). The triac never turns off on a DC load, and loads under 0.1 A (small LED bulbs) can glow or fail to switch off because of the snubber's leakage current.
Zero-cross switching: the output turns on and off at the next mains zero crossing (up to 1/2 cycle + 1 ms). It cannot dim (no phase control) and is too slow for PWM.

Mains wiring on the A1/B1 screw terminal is dangerous: put the SSR in series with the live wire, keep it in a closed insulated box, and never touch the module while it is plugged in. Leave mains to an adult/qualified person.
Derate the 2 A rating when hot or when several SSRs are mounted together (Omron: halve the load current with poor ventilation). The 2 A fuse on the module protects only against gross overload.
Power DC+ from 5 V and share DC- with the microcontroller's GND; CH1 draws about 2 mA, so a GPIO can drive it directly.

example.code:
from machine import Pin
import time

ssr = Pin({CH1}, Pin.OUT, value=0)  # CH1 high = SSR on (high level trigger module)
while True:
    ssr.value(1)
    print('SSR ON')
    time.sleep(2)
    ssr.value(0)
    print('SSR OFF')
    time.sleep(2)

test.title: The SSR switches on, then off again
